Hi Alice / Bob,

Thanks again for the call today - really appreciate the context on the search relevancy use case and the traffic patterns you shared. As promised, attached is a lightweight POC template + a proposed plan to make the trial actionable. High level recap / ask:

- Goal: validate that Redwood inference can meet Acme's latency & relevance targets on a representative slice of your queries, and quantify per-token cost for projected traffic.
- Proposed success criteria (draft):
  • Latency: 95th percentile generation latency < 200ms for 512-token requests
  • Quality: top-k relevance precision >= 0.78 on your labeled eval set (we'll use the sample you shared)
  • Throughput: sustain 50 QPS with under-provisioned buffer for spike handling
  • Integration: model endpoint reachable from your staging environment, and auth (API key/SSO) validated

Proposed timeline / milestones:
- Week 0 (prep): share sample dataset + test user list, create service account / API access (you) - target by Nov 14
- Kickoff: Nov 18 - technical alignment + runbook walkthrough
- Week 1 (Nov 18-25): initial endpoint + smoke tests; run preliminary eval
- Week 2 (Nov 25-Dec 2): iterate prompts/configs, run full eval suites; cost estimates
- Week 3 (Dec 2-9): final readout + next-steps (rollout, Dedicated options)

Owners (draft):
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (sales, program lead), Neha Kapoor (CS, POC execution)
- Acme: Alice Chen (product owner), Bob Torres (engineering lead)

Next steps for you: please confirm kickoff availability (we were thinking Nov 18, 10:00 AM PT) and whether you can share the sample dataset and the preferred method for credentials (SFTP, API token, or temporary S3 bucket).

I've attached the Redwood_POC_Template.pdf to this thread - it includes a checklist and data/credentials checklist. Once you confirm, I'll schedule the kickoff invite and loop in Neha for runbook ownership.


Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

- Cost: per-token and projected monthly cost at expected traffic (we'll provide a 90/95 CI)
